A couple tips in finding things worth casting at,

Wood is good - cast at those log jams or any fallen logs and trees or whatever of that sort, trout like to hide, wood makes a perfect hiding spot

Rocks Rock - Rocks divert the current and create slow zones under the surface, trout like to hide both in front and behind rocks and pick off food that drifts by it.

Pools Rule - anywhere that water pool is usually a good spot, cast at the head and tail of the pool and any rocks or logs or structure thats visible, and also cast into the middle/deepest part of the pool

Foam is Home, anywhere that water is moving faster creates these foam lines of bubbles on the edges, trout hide in these foam lines and pick off food that moves through the current.
